title: Survivors Conquest
description: The Official Pack for The Survivors Conquest Minecraft Server
body:
This is the pack for the Survivors Conquest Minecraft server

In this pack you can:

Make food and drinks with farmers delight

Explore and Loot with improved structures

Fly around in planes, play music and have brand new enchantments

This is an all around amazing modpack, wether you want to play on the server, or just play solo on this Brilliant Vanilla + Pack

Discord : https://discord.gg/McmhSg3MMq
